title: Titan Holds Distribution of Five Star Stories Manga's 1st English Volume to Review Translation Situation
content:
ANN reached out to Titan Manga . A spokesperson from Titan Manga provided the following comment:

"We take the quality and integrity of our translations extremely seriously and fully recognize the gravity of this situation. As a precaution, we have placed a hold on distribution while we review the situation and determine the appropriate next steps. We remain committed to delivering an English edition that respects the original work and meets the standards fans deserve."

The company did not specify what the translation situation was in its comments. The first English volume credits Greco D. Espinoza as the translator.

In addition to a previous unfinished English release, the manga also had an controversial unofficial English translation.

Titan Manga and Newtype are planning to release the first English volume on December 1, following several delays. The companies were originally going to release the first volume on July 7, but delayed it to September 1, and then again to November 17.

Titan Manga describes the first volume:

Set in the vast and tumultuous Joker Star Cluster, this series brings together ancient empires, genetic engineering, and towering mechs known as Mortar Headds—piloted by elite warriors and their genetically engineered companions, the Fatimas. In Vol. 1, we meet Amaterasu, the immortal emperor of the Grees Kingdom, and his destined bride, Lachesis, as they navigate a world of intrigue, warfare, and forbidden power. As interstellar conflict rages, the stage is set for a war that could determine the fate of the galaxy.

Nagano launched his science fantasy manga series in Kadokawa 's Newtype magazine in 1986, although the series has been running intermittently since then. To mark the 25th anniversary of the manga in 2011, Kadokawa reissued the existing manga volumes in a "Repeat" edition with previously unpublished art.

The manga went on hiatus in 2006 and relaunched in the magazine's May 2013 issue. It went back on hiatus in spring 2014 as Nagano prepared the 13th compiled book volume for print. The manga resumed from its hiatus in February 2016. The 13th volume shipped in August 2016 after several delays. The 12th volume had shipped in 2006.

Kadokawa released the 19th and most recent compiled book volume on May 9.

Nagano's own Toyspress, Inc. published most of the manga in English. ADV Films released the 1989 anime film adaptation in North America.
author: ANN

title: Living It Up in Another World Until I Get Bored Novels Get TV Anime
content:
Hanashi Media licensed the light novels, and it describes the story:

As if the universe heard him, his journey begins sooner than expected. On his way home, he suddenly finds himself stranded in another world-a strange, game-like place governed by levels, magic, skills, and other fantastical rules. And before he knows it, he's acquired tremendous power without even having to work for it. With that kind of strength at his disposal, three paths lie before him: side with humanity and become a hero, join the demons and unleash chaos upon the world... or choose neither and use his newfound power for nothing more than his own amusement. For him, the choice is obvious. And so begins one thirty-something nobody's journey through another world, living exactly as he pleases until he gets bored!

Sanmongarasu debuted the web novel on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in June 2016. The first light novel volume with illustrations by Tomozo shipped in Japan in April 2019, and the eighth volume will ship on November 30. SAA debuted a manga adaptation in Shufunotomo 's Hero Comic in July 2025. Shufunotomo published the manga's first compiled book volume on September 30.

title: Gifted Baseball Webtoon Gets Live-Action TV Series Adaptation Premiering on December 5
content:
Kakao Entertainment announced on Friday a live-action television adaptation of Jung1212's baseball webtoon Gifted will premiere on tvN on December 5 at 9:10 p.m. KST.

The webtoon follows Min-yong Jeong, a baseball coach who gains the ability to see players' natural talents and limits to their potential after an accident. He takes over a high school baseball team ranked last nationwide and attempts to recruit Tae-hoon Cha, a player with exceptional natural talent. However, this threatens the position of Seung-il Heo, a pitcher who has worked hard to earn recognition through his efforts.

The story explores the tension between natural talent and hard work, following the players as they confront their own limitations and compete for opportunities. It also depicts the coach and the parents who support their children through the pressures of competitive sports.

Woo-bin Kim stars as Min-yong Jeong, while Eun-soo Seo plays Seo-jin Yoon, a physical education teacher who works to protect the baseball team. Chabin and Si-hyun Han portray Seung-il Heo and Tae-hoon Cha, respectively.

The original webtoon by Jung1212 has been serialized on Kakao Page since 2021.

Jung1212 said the opportunity to adapt the webtoon into a television drama was an unexpected gift. The artist also explained that the story reflects personal doubts about their own talent and creative abilities, adding that viewers may find more meaning in the characters' struggles when considering the questions of talent, effort, and accepting the results of one's work.

Fans can read the official English version of the webtoon on Tapas .

A North American release of the live-action series is not yet confirmed.

title: Aquaman Romance Webtoon Gets Japanese Live-Action Series Premiering on December 25
content:
Kakao Entertainment announced on Thursday McQueen Studio's romance webtoon Aquaman is being adapted into a Japanese live-action series by Fuji TV . The 10-episode series will premiere simultaneously in Japan and South Korea on December 25 through Fuji TV 's streaming service and Wavve , a Korean streaming platform, respectively.

The original webtoon ran from 2016 to 2019 and recorded approximately 200 million cumulative views on Kakao Page . It follows longtime friends whose relationship becomes complicated as the boundaries between friendship and romance blur.

The now-defunct service Spottoon had previously released the series in English and describes the story:

Jump into the life of twenty-something Naru as he navigates through the confusing world of modern dating. He's faced with familiar moments we've all been through such as “should I add that smiley face at the end of the text?” or “why haven't they responded to my text?” But the added challenge for Naru? He's never dated, doesn't use a cellphone and most importantly someone's out there to sabotage his dating life!

The series is a joint adaptation project between Kakao Entertainment and Fuji TV . Kakao Entertainment provided the original intellectual property and participated in the planning and development, while Fuji TV is handling the Japanese production in collaboration with production company AOI Pro.

Haru Kashiwagi stars as Naru Shintani, based on the original character Naru Shin. Noritaka Hamao plays Kazunari Ikeda, adapted from Sung-joon Choi, while Karen Ōtomo portrays Sora Hoshino, based on Sora Choi.

Junichi Kanai is directing the series, with Erika Seki writing the screenplay. New episodes will premiere every Friday following the December 25 debut.

Currently, an official English version of the webtoon is not available.

A North American release of the live-action series is not yet confirmed.

title: Purge List Webtoon's Live-Action Film Adaptation Begins Production for 2027 Release
content:
The live-action film adaptation of the webtoon Purge List has begun production, with actors Woo-sung Jung , Sung-il Jung, and Ha-joon Wi among its cast members. According to Korean news outlet YTN on November 5, the film is scheduled to premiere in theaters in 2027.

The historical action film centers on Joseon-era political figure Myeong-hoe Han ( Woo-sung Jung ), a ruthless power broker, and the people whose lives become entangled with his political purges. Sung-il Jung plays Banseok, the leader of a secret organization opposing Han, while Ha-joon Wi portrays Prince Suyang, who seeks to claim the throne.

The supporting cast includes Chang-seok Go as general Jong-seo Kim. Ji-hwan Park, Daniel Choi, and Sung-wook Lee will play members of the Six Martyred Ministers. Other supporting cast members include Gwi-hwa Choi, Bok-rae Jo, Bong-sik Hyun, Yoon-sik Baek, and Moo-sung Choi.

The original webtoon by Jong-hoon Kim gained attention after winning the grand prize at the inaugural Daum Online Comics Contest. The webtoon has recorded 120 million cumulative views on Kakao Webtoon, where it had been serialized between 2014 and 2015.

Currently, an official English version of the webtoon is not available.

title: Stage Musical Adaptation of Webtoon The Siren: Becoming the Villain's Family to Premiere in Seoul on March 24, 2027
content:
Korean musical production company ShowNote announced on October 28 that its upcoming stage musical The Siren will run from March 24 to June 13, 2027, at the Charlotte Theater in Seoul.

The musical is based on Sol Leesu's popular romance-fantasy web novel Siren: I Became a Contract Family with the Villain . Poya also adapted the novel into the webtoon The Siren: Becoming the Villain's Family , which has garnered over 220 million views on Kakao Page and Kakao Webtoon services.

The story follows Lloyd, the grand duke of the Valentine family, which has been afflicted by a demonic curse for generations. Aria, a siren whose voice can move people's hearts, holds the key to lifting his curse.

The English version of the The Siren: Becoming the Villain's Family webtoon is available on Tapas . The original web novel does not have an official English release.

title: Omniscient Reader, Greatest Estate Developer, Debut or Die!, 7 More Works Win 2026 World Webtoon Awards
content:
South Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) announced on November 3 the 10 main award winners of the 2026 World Webtoon Awards, including Omniscient Reader .

The winners are:

• Return of the Blossoming Blade

• Cry, or Better Yet, Beg

• Omniscient Reader

• My S-Class Hunters

• Jakdu: Shaman's Blade

• Debut or Die!

• On the Way to Meet Mom

• The Greatest Estate Developer

• Killer Peter

• A Man's Man

The awards had announced the 20 finalists in September. This year's awards received 7,318 nominations from 4,038 fans worldwide, with 941 works submitted in total.

Now in its third year, the World Webtoon Awards recognizes outstanding webtoons from around the world, without restrictions on creators' nationalities or the regions where their works are serialized. Each of the 10 winners will receive a trophy and 10 million won (about US$7,200).

The awards ceremony will take place on December 3 at Starfield Library in COEX Mall, Seoul. The grand prize and Judges' Award winners will be selected from the 10 main award recipients at the ceremony. The grand prize winner will receive an additional 5 million won (about US$3,600), while the Judges' Award winner will receive an additional 3 million won (about US$2,200).

The World Webtoon Festival will also run from December 2 to 6 at COEX Hall B and the surrounding Starfield COEX Mall area. The festival will feature special exhibitions showcasing domestic and international webtoons and intellectual property, as well as events and activities for creators and fans.

title: ATASHIn'CHI Next Net Anime's Additional Episodes Debut on January 1
content:
Shinei Animation announced on Friday that the planned new episodes for ATASHIn'CHI Next , the latest net anime for the ATASHIn'CHI franchise, will debut on the franchise's YouTube channel on January 1 at 6:00 p.m. JST. New episodes will stream on the first Friday of every month at 6:00 p.m. JST.

The anime's website also revealed a key visual, more staff, the main returning cast, and the theme song artist.

As previously announced, Taku Kimura ( Chainsmoker Cat ) is directing the anime. Masae Ōtake is designing the characters. Kinmokusei is performing the opening and ending theme song, titled "Saraba" (Farewell).

Returning cast members include:

• Daisuke Sakaguchi as Yuzuhiko

• Fumiko Orikasa as Mikan

• Kenichi Ogata as Father

• Kumiko Watanabe as Mother

The first batch of five episodes of the anime debuted with a monthly schedule per episode from June to October 2024.

The next batch of five new episodes debuted on November 20, 2025; December 20, 2025; and this year on January 20, February 20, and March 20.

The anime commemorates the 30th anniversary of Eiko Kera 's original manga. The series animates stories in the original manga that were not adapted in the previous anime.

The manga inspired a television anime series that aired from 2002 to 2009. The ATASHIn'CHI film premiered in 2003, followed by the 40-minute 3D ATASHIn'CHI film in 2010. A new television anime series titled Shin ATASHIn'CHI premiered in October 2015, and ended in April 2016. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in Japan.

The official YouTube channel for the anime has been streaming the series and Shin ATASHIn'CHI with English subtitles since May 2020.

Shinei Animation and AlphaBoat describe the anime's story:

ATASHIn'CHI ... describes the everyday life of the Tachibana family: Mother, who tries her best in everything she does despite her clumsiness; Father, who says little and insists on doing everything his way; Mikan, a high school romantic; and Yuzuhiko, who might appear to be emotionless at first glance but is quite naïve.

Kera launched a new serialization for the manga titled ATASHIn'CHI SUPER in December 2019, seven years after she originally ended the series. When Kera ended the manga in March 2012, she had been drawing it in the Sunday edition of the Yomiuri Shimbun newspaper since 1994, for 17 years and 10 months.

title: Stars Shinnosuke Tokudome, Shūichirō Umeda Perform Ending Theme for Ore to Yu Nii! Anime
content:
The official website for Ore to Yu Nii! (Me and Older Brother Yu), the television anime based on Miyuki Nakayama 's Shota x Oni (or Shota Oni ) boys-love manga , revealed on Friday that the anime's stars Shinnosuke Tokudome and Shūichirō Umeda will perform the ending theme song "Pure Heart Beat."

Noriko Hashimoto ( Given movies 2024 ) is directing the anime and Yuniko Ayana ( Given TV , BanG Dream! ) is overseeing the series scripts. Studio Hibari is animating the series. Yumi Kuroiwa (sub-character design for HYPNOSISMIC -Division Rap Battle- Rhyme Anima PLUS (TV 2) ) is designing the characters, and Yukari Hashimoto ( I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day , Mr. Osomatsu ) and Ruka Kawada ( Is the order a rabbit? , The Invisible Man and His Soon-to-Be Wife ) are composing the music at Pony Canyon .

Other staff members include:

• Art Director: Hirofune Hane

• Color Design: Saki Tada

• Director of Photography: Sena Nakagawa

• Sound Director: Takeshi Takadera

The story centers on an elementary school boy named Tsubaki and his childhood friend Yū, who is in high school. Tsubaki loves Yū, but Yū always treats Tsubaki like a child. Tsubaki thinks, "I'll grow up quickly so I can make Yū happy!"

Nakayama ( Blend S , Spirits & Cat Ears ) debuted the manga on the Comic CMOA website as part of the launch for Square Enix 's boys-love manga label "Gangan BLiss" in September 2021. The series is also on Manga UP! , ebookjapan, LINE Manga , and Kindle Store. Square Enix published the manga's seventh volume on March 21.

The manga won the Best Next Generation (Newcomer) award at boys-love website Chil-Chil's 13th annual BL Awards in 2022.

title: Multi-Mind Mayhem: Isekai Tensei Soudouki Anime Reveals January 6 Debut, More Cast in 2nd Promo Video
content:
The official website for the television anime of author Ryōsen Takami and illustrator Ririnra 's Multi-Mind Mayhem: Isekai Tensei Soudouki ( Isekai Tensei Sōdōki ) light novel series revealed on Friday the January 6 debut, six new cast members, the opening theme song, the ending theme song, second key visual, and second promotional video.

The newly announced cast members include:

• Marina Inoue as Maggot

• Takehito Koyasu as Ignis

• Toshiki Kumagai as Brooks

• Ari Ozawa as Teresa

• Kōhei Yanagi as William

• Yuki Sakakihara as Franco

Maverick Mom performs the opening theme song “Isekai” (Another World) and VTuber Tokino Sora performs the ending theme “Brand New Day.”

The first episode will debut on January 6 at 10:00 p.m. on Tokyo MX and later that evening on BS Fuji . The series will later air on AT-X on January 8. The anime will stream on d Anime Store , ABEMA , and U-NEXT on January 6 at 10:30 p.m., and these services will debut the first two episodes at the same time. Afterward, streaming services will debut new episodes weekly one week before they air on television.

Other previously announced cast includes :

• Takashi Matsuyama as Sanai Oka

• Satoshi Inomata as Masaharu Oka

• Yukari Anzai as Seillune

• Ayasa Itō as Selina

• Sumire Morohoshi as Silke

Hiroaki Sakurai ( Di Gi Charat ) is directing the anime at Studio DEEN . Keiichirō Ōchi ( The Quintessential Quintuplets ) is handling the series composition. Zenjirō Ukulele ( My Wife Has No Emotion ) is designing the characters based on Hajime Watanabe 's ( School Rumble ) original designs. Ryoshi Takagi is composing the music.

One Peace Books is publishing Honoji 's manga adaptation in English in print, and Alpha Manga is also publishing the manga in English digitally. One Peace Books describes the story:

Bard Cornelius: the son of a nobleman of Mauricia, an empire located in a parallel universe. But Bard is no ordinary boy―he's got three souls packed into one body! Aside from his own consciousness, he's got Oka Sanai, a miserly samurai, and Masaharu Oka, a high school otaku who loves animal ears. With his extra knowledge of military tactics and business acumen, Bard's ready to cheat his way to the top! Get ready to enjoy the manga version of this hit isekai light novel series!

AlphaPolis published the first novel volume in March 2014, and published the 14th volume in February 2019.

Honoji launched the manga adaptation on AlphaPolis in 2015. AlphaPolis published the manga's 14th compiled book volume on March 18. One Peace Books published the manga's ninth volume in March 2024.

Ari Ozawa as Teresa
Kōhei Yanagi as William
Yuki Sakakihara as Franco
Maverick Mom performs the opening theme song “Isekai” (Another World) and VTuber Tokino Sora performs the ending theme “Brand New Day.”

Afterward, streaming services will debut new episodes weekly one week before they air on television.
